title: Q18
description:
List each OT text quoted in 1:5–13 (Psa 2:7; 2Sa 7:14; Deut 32:43 [Greek]; Psa 104:4; Psa 45:6–7; Psa 102:25–27; Psa 110:1).
a) For each, note its wider setting in the OT: who speaks, to whom, and in what situation.
b) What does that setting bring forward that the quoted words alone would not?
